name: --mouse
description: Enable or disable mouse support in the interactive interface. VALUE can be on (default) or off. When enabled, the CLI captures mouse events—scroll wheel, clicks, and so on—to navigate its own interface, such as scrolling the timeline or clicking tabs. When disabled, the terminal's native mouse behavior, such as text selection and scrollback, is preserved. When you set this option explicitly, the value is persisted to your configuration file.
